about: Genuine Bazel 9.3.0 shutdown/clean/fetch captures (tests/fixtures/cmd_clean_fetch/capture.py, docs/COMMANDS.md): --batch --ignore_all_rc_files --output_user_root=<private>, env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<private>; the cases run in order against one output base; the quiet_ cases (startup --quiet) run in server mode against a second output user root, after the others. `stderr` keeps the lines matching KEPT, `stderr_full` everything but the JVM warning; <OUTPUT_BASE> is the output base (native: the workspace's state directory); `output_exists` = <OUTPUT_BASE>/execroot/_main/bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/pkg/g.txt after the case; `downloads` = HTTP requests for the archive.
module:
module(name = "scratch")
http_archive = use_repo_rule("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")
http_archive(name = "remote", urls = ["http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/remote.tar.gz"], sha256 = "6322c0df89f30a6feb0ff9aae3fe3bc709fc3be945cea1be7fc3e5858126ec58", strip_prefix = "remote-1")
